# A binary's build info records a module's h1 sum, even when the module cache
# records that module's git sum, so one go.sum stamps one dep line everywhere.
env GO111MODULE=on

go build -o zipped$GOEXE .
go version -m zipped$GOEXE
stdout '^\tdep\trsc.io/quote\tv1.5.2\th1:3fEykkD9k7lYzXqCYrwGAf7iNhbk4yCjHmKBN9td4L0=$'

# The cache now records the git sum a GitHub archive leaves.
cp gitsum $GOPATH/pkg/mod/cache/download/rsc.io/quote/@v/v1.5.2.ziphash
go build -o archived$GOEXE .
go version -m archived$GOEXE
stdout '^\tdep\trsc.io/quote\tv1.5.2\th1:3fEykkD9k7lYzXqCYrwGAf7iNhbk4yCjHmKBN9td4L0=$'
! stdout 'git:'

go mod download -json rsc.io/quote
stdout '"Sum": "h1:3fEykkD9k7lYzXqCYrwGAf7iNhbk4yCjHmKBN9td4L0="'
! stdout 'git:'

-- go.mod --
module m

go 1.15

require rsc.io/quote v1.5.2
-- go.sum --

-- main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"rsc.io/quote"
)

	fmt.Println(quote.Hello())
}
